text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work until five, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, and relax with my family. I go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel healthy, focused, and calm every day.
